shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in a cobalt blouse speaks in the plant-side window seat, a man in an olive jacket sits in the counter-side window seat, and a woman in a burgundy cardigan sits in the plant-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with the full table and all three seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in an olive jacket leaves the counter-side window seat and exits the venue. The woman in a cobalt blouse asks a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a cobalt blouse replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from behind the plant-end seat, looking lengthwise along the table toward the café counter, with the entire table, the plant-end seat, and both window-side seats in frame.
